feeds.title: Underwater Hockey Australia
feeds.description: Underwater Hockey Australia is the official website of the Australian Underwater Hockey Commission. The UHA does all the promoting, developing, and regulating the sport both nationally and internationally. Their blog site covers news regarding the latest updates in Underwater hockey, such as 2023 Australian nationals, Australian team coaches & managers, and team coaching appointments.

feeds.title: Sportalsub.net » Underwater Hockey
feeds.description: Sportalsub.net website is dedicated to information on the world of underwater activities in Spanish. Finswimming, Spearfishing, Underwater Rugby, Hockey Underwater, Underwater Photography, Underwater Video, Target Shooting Underwater, Underwater Orientation. Underwater Conservation of the Environment, Courses, Training, and everything related to the underwater world.

feeds.title: Underwater Hockey Club Zurich Blog
feeds.description: Underwater Hockey also is known as Octopush is a globally played limited-contact sport in which two teams compete to maneuver a puck across the bottom of a swimming pool into the opposing team's goal by propelling it with a hockey stick.

feeds.title: Hydro Underwater Hockey
feeds.description: Hydro Underwater Hockey is committed to bringing you a range of premium underwater hockey gear at affordable prices. Developing new technology in manufacturing Underwater Hockey Sports equipment, in New Zealand, designs Uwh gear for the global Octopush community.
